object.attr: derived: CF-S9, CF-S10, D29. The Document ID definition now limits the characters to A–Z, a–z, 0–9, hyphen and underscore and excludes Windows device names (Decided on 2026-11-10, Q-S8). A folder named otherwise by hand would reach issue tags, links and file names unchecked, and a device name breaks each Windows checkout.
object.description: If the name of a document folder isn't a document ID, Mellon shall report a load error for the document.
